source.note: Checklist, insert hierarchy, teams, and published insertion ratios were cross-checked from public reference pages. Promos are intentionally excluded from VCS packs.

decisions.packChannelAbstraction: VCS uses one universal pack. Series-exclusive insert odds are weighted by the 330/220 base-card series split; channel-exclusive insert families remain available in the universal VCS pack.
decisions.parallelRepresentation: Press Proofs are a distinct non-base Product Set derived from all 550 base cards. Current VCS schema has no explicit isParallel flag, so bundle metadata preserves kind=PARALLEL while database flags remain isBase=false/isInsert=false.

productSets.name: All Stars
productSets.notes: AL cards are Series One and NL cards are Series Two. Published at 1:8 in their applicable pack format; combined VCS odds remain 1:8.

productSets.name: Bomb Squad
productSets.notes: Series One only, 1:24 in applicable Retail packs. Combined-series VCS odds: 0.6 x 1/24 = 1/40.

productSets.name: Diamond Kings
productSets.notes: 14 cards in Series One and 15 in Series Two; 1:10 Hobby/Retail in both series.

productSets.name: Dominators
productSets.notes: Series Two only, 1:24 Hobby. Combined-series VCS odds: 0.4 x 1/24 = 1/60.

productSets.name: Elite Series
productSets.notes: #49-54 Series One 1:210 Hobby/Retail; #55-60 Series Two 1:180 Hobby/Retail. Weighted combined-series rate rounds to 1:197. All cards SN10000.

productSets.name: Long Ball Leaders
productSets.notes: Series One only, 1:24 Hobby. Combined-series VCS odds: 0.6 x 1/24 = 1/40.

productSets.name: Mound Marvels
productSets.notes: Series Two only, 1:16 Retail. Combined-series VCS odds: 0.4 x 1/16 = 1/40. Cards had removable protective film.

productSets.name: Press Proofs
productSets.notes: Full 550-card base parallel, limited but not serial-numbered to 2000 copies. S1 1:20 and S2 1:24 Hobby/Retail; weighted rate is about 1:21.4, represented as 1:21 because VCS odds are integer denominators.
